name: claude-mods
description: Mods for Claude Code by Gal: mermaid diagrams drawn inline in the transcript; /q holds a prompt until the turn ends; highlight a reply to quote it in the prompt; click a path to open it beside the session.

plugins.name: claude-mermaid
plugins.description: Mermaid diagrams drawn as box art inline in the transcript.

plugins.name: claude-queue
plugins.description: /q <text> while Claude is working waits in a stack above the prompt and goes out when the turn ends.

plugins.name: claude-quote
plugins.description: Highlight what Claude said and click once: it is quoted in the prompt box.

plugins.name: claude-open
plugins.description: Click a file path in a reply: it opens in a herdr pane to the right, markdown in leaf.
